title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: balance floor for applying an employer payment
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, an employer's payment toward an enrollment's dues is applied in full against whatever that enrollment currently shows owed. If that owed amount is negative — meaning the enrollment currently shows a credit rather than an amount owed — it is treated as zero for this purpose, so a credit balance is never further reduced by applying a payment.

Worked example (hypothetical): if an enrollment currently showed a credit balance, applying a payment against it would still floor the amount available to apply at zero, rather than deepening that credit.
